candidate_evidence.quote: A humanised immunoglobulin G4 (IgG4) monoclonal antibody (mAb) specific for the programmed cell death 1 (PD-1) receptor

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: T Cells and Pembrolizumab for Recurrent and Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: A humanised immunoglobulin G4 (IgG4) monoclonal antibody (mAb) specific for the programmed cell death 1 (PD-1) receptor
Allogeneic cytomegalovirus (CMV)-specific T cells generated from the blood of healthy CMV-seropositive donors

coder_notes: Pembrolizumab is the only pharmacological investigational agent; the T-cell product is an excluded cell therapy. Detailed description mentions T cells as monotherapy in some groups, but all registered arms list both interventions. CMV serology and HLA matching are patient/donor requirements, not tumour biomarkers.
